title: ops stewardship microcanary communication templates (wip)
content:
Summary:
This working doc collects short, copy-ready communication templates and a lightweight stewardship checklist for microcanaries and small phased rollouts. The goal is to reduce friction when launching small experiments that still need human coordination: ensure messengers are clear, receivers know action expectations, and theres a minimal signal ladder for escalation.

Context and constraints (notes to self):
- Microcanaries here = <1% of traffic or narrow cohort slices exposed over hours/days.
- Always expect noisy signals: latency blips, transient error spikes, spammy user queries. Communications should make it easy to ignore non-actionable noise while highlighting what matters.
- This doc assumes product + SRE + Observability + Solutions (if customer-facing) involvement.
- Keep messages short and include a single required action if any.

Steward roles (recommended minimal roster):
- Release Steward (owner) - coordinates the run, posts activation notes, fields questions. Recommended: PM or Product Ops.
- Steward SRE - watches infra signals, owns revert/runbook execution.
- Telemetry Lead - ensures dashboards are open and samples are being collected.
- Comms Lead - crafts customer-facing notes if needed, posts to status.
- Coverage: one person may cover multiple roles for small canaries.

Pre-activation checklist (Slack/Email template included below):
- Confirm time window and rollback window (e.g., 11:00-14:00 PT, 60m stable before next step).
- Validate experiment config, traffic slice ids, and target cohort definition.
- Ensure dashboards link works + 10 synthetic probes running for at least 30m.
- PagerDuty routing: ensure Steward SRE is on-call or has a backup.
- Notify major dependents (billing, on-call, CS if customer-facing).

Template: pre-activation slack message (channel #release-ops / #canaries)
---
@channel Heads-up: microcanary activation in 30m for feature: <short-name>
Owner: Maya Patel (release steward)
Slice: 0.3% of user-search traffic (slice-id: s-142)
Window: 2025-01-27 11:00-14:00 PT
Runbook: <link-to-runbook> | Dashboards: <link-to-dashboards>
Required: If you see >2x error-rate vs baseline for 10m OR latency p95 > 1200ms for 5m, ping @steward-sre and escalate to #oncall.
No action expected for transient single-minute blips.
---
Notes: Keep the pre-activation note on a single screen. Use explicit thresholds to avoid noisy pings.

Activation: short status and probe reminder
- Post 5m after activation: "Microcanary: activated. Observability: green/amber/red. First synthetic run: PASS/FAIL."
- If amber, include next step (increase sampling, continue to observe 30m).

Template: 5-minute check slack message
---
Microcanary update: feature <short-name> activated 11:00 PT (slice s-142).
Telemetry: error-rate +15% vs baseline (rolling 5m) — currently amber.
Action: Steward SRE to investigate logs and confirm whether to continue observe or revert.
If no human updates in 10m and alert persists, auto-revert will be triggered.
---

Reversion notice (if revert triggered) - Slack + Incident stub
---
Reversion: microcanary for <short-name> reverted at 11:28 PT (trigger: sustained error-rate >2x for 12m).
Who: Steward SRE (Alejandro Ruiz) executed revert.
Impact: slice s-142 (0.3%) rolled back; customer-facing traffic unaffected beyond slice.
Follow-up: postmortem owners: Maya (prod), Alejandro (sre), Priya (telemetry). Meeting: T+24h sync TBD.
Incident stub: <link-to-incident-template>
---
Tone guidance: neutral, fact-first, include concrete numbers. Dont assign blame in-channel.

Post-activation quick template (when activation finishes without reversion)
---
Microcanary complete: feature <short-name> observed for 3h and met stability criteria (error-rate within 10% baseline, latency stable).
Next: consider expanding to 1% (owner to propose next step).
Notes: collect user samples + golden prompt set for QA regression checks.
---

Customer-facing status blurb (short) - for CS/Support to use
---
Short update: We ran a small rollout of <feature> today for a subset of users and observed stable performance. No customer-facing impact. Please escalate any odd behavior to support@redwood.ai.
---

Escalation ladder (signal ladder) - keep this baked into all messages
1) Pager (SEV) - sustained infra signal (errors, database errors, unrecoverable resource exhaustion). Immediate revert.
2) Steward channel alert (High) - persistent service degradation (>2x error for >10m, or latency p95 > threshold). Human triage + revert within 15-30m if unresolved.
3) Observation-only (Low) - single-window spikes, noisy queries, minor regression in quality metrics. Keep observing, log samples, and escalate if pattern emerges.

Quick checklist for steward to post in every update (copy/paste):
- time-window:
- slice id:
- telemetry state (green/amber/red):
- recent action taken (none/investigating/reverted):
- required next action and owner:

Communication templates: example email to execs (short)
Subject: Microcanary <feature> — quick status (11:00 PT start)
Body:
- Start: 11:00 PT; slice: 0.3%
- Current state: amber (error-rate +15% rolling 5m)
- Action: SRE investigating logs, revert on sustained error threshold.
- Expected next update: 11:20 PT

Playbook fragment: when to auto-revert vs require human revert (suggested conservative defaults)
- Auto-revert: sustained infra-level errors (gateway 5xx) for >10m OR memory/OOM signs on worker pool.
- Human revert required: model quality regressions (semantic failures, hallucinations) where human review may allow temporary tolerance. Human must explicitly revert within 30m.

Unresolved questions / TODOs (working list):
- Should we borrow specific templates from the release-runbook repo to auto-fill slice ids? (Jira RF-7421)
- Identify one canonical channel for microcanary chatter so alerts are easy to page. Right now teams split between #release-ops and team-specific channels.
- Consider a short templating function in the console to post these messages automatically (reduce human typing errors).

Appendix: quick copy-paste message snippets
- Pre-activation (one-liner): "Heads-up: microcanary for <feature> in 30m (s-XXX). Owner: <name>. Dashboards: <link>. Required action: ping @steward-sre if sustained error >2x or latency p95 >1.2s."
- Activation OK: "Activated: microcanary <feature> (s-XXX). Observability: green. Next check in 15m."
- Revert summary: "Reverted: microcanary <feature> at <time>. Trigger: <metric>. Revert executed by <name>. Incident: <link>."

Notes to collaborators:
- Jordan: can you vet the suggested thresholds with SRE on-call patterns?
- Priya: can you stub a short status-blurb template in Support docs?
- Alejandro: include the runbook link and exact rollback command in the runbook before we use this template live.

History & provenance (brief):
- Drafted 2024-11-14 during postmortem for RF-7310 microcanary.
- Iterated with SRE and Product Ops 2024-12 through 2025-01.

End of doc.

-- NOTE: This is intentionally concise; the UX of communication matters more than exhaustive policies. Keep it visible and editable in Drive near rollouts playbooks.
